Computing MRQ-YoY off the mislabeled rows gives a false ~19.1-19.2% growth number. The COMPANY-CONFIRMED Q4 FY26 vs Q4 FY25 YoY growth is +14.4% revenue / +14.1% PAT (per Mphasis press release / EquityBulls / Univest coverage of the Apr-2026 results) — always reconcile aggregator quarter labels against the official press release before trusting a YoY delta.

DIVIDEND YIELD METHOD TRAP: Because Mphasis pays a single annual (final-only) dividend with a July ex-date, two full annual dividends (FY25's ₹57, ex-date 9-Jul-2025, and FY26's ₹62, ex-date 8-Jul-2026) both fall inside the trailing-12-month window right now. A naive TTM-sum dividend yield (₹119/price ≈ 5.3%, as Trendlyne computes) is roughly DOUBLE the conventional latest-FY-dividend yield (₹62/price ≈ 2.77%, as Screener computes) — these are not comparable and sources disagree because of this timing quirk, not because of a data error.

EX-DIVIDEND PRICE DISTORTION: The as-of date for this pack (8-Jul-2026) is also the ex-date/record date for the ₹62 final dividend. REPORTED (INR) vs CONSTANT-CURRENCY (USD) GROWTH: Mphasis's own releases distinguish 'Gross Revenue' growth on a reported INR basis from constant-currency USD growth — Q4 FY26 was +14.4% YoY reported INR but only ~+7.1% YoY in constant-currency USD terms. Never quote one as the other.

STANDALONE vs CONSOLIDATED: Coverage of the FY26 annual results (Whalesbook) explicitly notes consolidated profit grew strongly while STANDALONE (parent-only) profit declined. All figures in this pack are CONSOLIDATED — standalone-only comparisons would look very different.

MARKET CAP / SHARE COUNT DISAGREEMENT: Screener's cap (₹42,794cr @ ₹2,242) implies ~19.09cr shares outstanding, consistent with Mphasis's long-stable share count (no split; only 1:1 bonus issues in 2003, 2004 and 2005, pre-current-listing era).
